assumptions: The UI and API share one origin
The operator receives the admin key out of band
decisions: Build public and operator workspaces in server-served HTML/CSS/JavaScript
Generate one idempotency key per intentional create operation
Use safe DOM text assignment for API-derived values
evidence: Acceptance requires keyboard reachability, visible focus, aria-live status, no horizontal page overflow, action-specific loading, safe text rendering, and preserved API tests
Admin key must remain in page memory only and travel only in X-Admin-Key
risks: Admin secrets may leak if persisted
Long URLs and dense analytics require responsive rendering
The visual language must remain original rather than copying third-party branding
summary: Defined testable acceptance criteria for creation, copy/open, responsive behavior, accessibility, loading/error states, admin listing, analytics, and confirmed disablement.
